title: Tribe Hotel
description: High-end property featuring modern quarters, plus a chic rooftop bar, an outdoor pool & a 24/7 gym.
hotelDescription:
Next to The Village Market shopping and recreation complex, this high-end hotel in a contemporary stone building is 8 km from the National Museums of Kenya.
 Modern, warmly decorated rooms come with free Wi-Fi, smart TVs and desks. Most have rainfall showers. Suites add living areas with sofas. Some bi-level suites offer loft offices or free-standing baths. Upgrades feature luxe decor and separate living rooms. Room service is available.
 There's a refined restaurant, a French-bakery and a chic rooftop bar. Other perks include a 24-hour fitness centre, a spa and an outdoor pool, plus a library and an airport shuttle.

title: Safari Park Hotel & Casino
description: Cosy quarters in a buzzy property with event space, a casino & dining, plus live shows & a pool.
hotelDescription:
This lively resort in 20 hectares of gardens is 10 km from wildlife in Karura Forest and 20 km from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport.
 Cosy, Colonial-style rooms have satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and patios with garden views. Suites add living areas, and tea and coffeemaking facilities; upgraded suites have kitchenettes and whirlpool baths. Up to 2 kids age 11 and under stay at no charge with a parent.
 There are 8 bars and restaurants, as well as a casino, a nightclub and live shows. Other amenities include a beach, an outdoor pool, a fitness centre and a spa, plus sports courts, gardens and an expansive conference centre. Breakfast is available.

title: Trademark Hotel
description: Casual rooms, some with balconies, plus a contemporary restaurant, 5 conference rooms & a ballroom.
address: Village Market, Limuru Rd, Nairobi, Kenya
hotelDescription:
This contemporary business hotel opposite a shopping mall is 7 km from Highway A104. It’s also within 8 km of the entrance to Karura Forest, a nature preserve with caves and waterfalls, and the zoo at Snake Park.
 Casual rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and en suite bathrooms with rainfall showers. They also feature work desks and laptop safes. Some have balconies, and suites add bathtubs.
 There’s a modern, airy restaurant and a low-key cafe. Other amenities include 5 sleek conference rooms, and a ballroom that can accommodate 550 guests.

title: Holiday Inn Nairobi Two Rivers Mall by IHG
description: Unpretentious hotel offering a rooftop pool & a gym, plus a bar & a 24-hour restaurant.
hotelDescription:
Opposite Two Rivers Mall, home to shops, an amusement park and a water park, this casual hotel is 10 km from Karura Forest and 33 km from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport.
 The unpretentious rooms offer flat-screens, and tea and coffeemaking facilites. Suites add microwaves and dining areas.
 In addition to a rooftop pool and a gym, there's a relaxed 24-hour restaurant and a bar. Other amenities include meeting rooms, parking and breakfast.
